samples.xml_description:
<module id="barrel_shifter">
    <description>A barrel shifter for rotating bits efficiently. This 8-bit barrel shifter takes an 8-bit input and shifts or rotates the bits based on a 3-bit control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input data to be shifted.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">A 3-bit control signal that specifies the number of positions to rotate/shift the input. Each bit corresponds to a stage of shifting: ctrl[2] rotates/shifts by 4 positions, ctrl[1] rotates/shifts by 2 positions, and ctrl[0] rotates/shifts by 1 position.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit output data after rotation/shifting.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic"></logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Intermediate wires for each stage of muxes
        wire [7:0] s1, s2, s3;
        
        // Stage 1: Rotate by 4 positions
        assign s1 = ctrl[2] ? {in[4:0], in[7:5]} : in;
        
        // Stage 2: Rotate by 2 positions
        assign s2 = ctrl[1] ? {s1[6:0], s1[7:7]} : s1;
        
        // Stage 3: Rotate by 1 position
        assign s3 = ctrl[0] ? {s2[7:0], s2[0]} : s2;
        
        // Final output assignment
        assign out = s3;
    </implementation>
    <task></task>
</module>
